PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX VideoGameOntology: <http://example.org/VideoGameOntology#>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?character) AS ?numberOfCharacters)
WHERE {
  ?session VideoGameOntology:involvesCharacter ?character .
  ?session VideoGameOntology:involvesAchievement ?achievement .
  ?game VideoGameOntology:hasLeaderboard ?leaderboard .
  ?leaderboard VideoGameOntology:isLeaderboardInGame ?game .
  FILTER(?achievement = <specific_achievement_uri>) # Replace with the specific achievement URI
  FILTER(?game = <particular_game_uri>) # Replace with the particular game URI
}

}
GROUP BY ?player
ORDER BY DESC(?sessionCount)
LIMIT 10
